recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if Imaging WG reopens the separate question of how DICOM UIDs should be encoded in Identifier.value, which is outside FHIR-37411.
issue_request: FHIR-37411 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Imaging Integration change request asking ImagingSelection UID elements modeled as oid to use id instead, matching ImagingStudy where appropriate; the accepted resolution was to apply the linked Confluence changes.
initial_application: The issue was applied by the ImagingSelection update history: issue-keyed commit 5c5a620527e102650cad53df57ff594d1706fe2a changed studyUid, seriesUid, frameOfReferenceUid, and instance.uid from oid to id, removed urn:oid: from those examples, and removed the separate instance.observationUid oid element. Jira also cites merge commit 471fbc468b8fd5427fcebad076569e16590ac707 for PR #2019.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini. Later ImagingSelection changes altered requirements and added DICOM UID Identifier guidance, but did not reverse the id-valued UID element decision; remaining urn:oid values are limited to SOP Class oid values or Identifier.value examples using system urn:dicom:uid.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current StructureDefinition uses id and plain valueId examples for ImagingSelection.studyUid, ImagingSelection.seriesUid, ImagingSelection.frameOfReferenceUid, and ImagingSelection.instance.uid; instance.observationUid is no longer present; and example UID-valued elements do not use urn:oid.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking ImagingSelection UID elements to use id instead of oid for consistency with ImagingStudy.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final accepted request for the current source check.

evidence_items.summary: The linked resolution page shows studyUid, seriesUid, frameOfReferenceUid, and instance.uid changing from oid to id and directs examples to remove urn:oid except for sopClass.code.
evidence_items.learned: This narrows the issue scope to id-valued UID elements and their examples, not Identifier-valued DICOM UIDs.
The inspected ImagingSelection source is in the current core build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Current studyUid, seriesUid, frameOfReferenceUid, and instance.uid use code id with plain valueId examples; sopClass remains oid.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current StructureDefinition already matches the FHIR-37411 resolution.

evidence_items.summary: Issue-keyed commit changed the affected ImagingSelection UID element types and examples from oid/urn:oid to id/plain values and removed instance.observationUid.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-37411 was explicitly applied in source history.

evidence_items.summary: Merge commit for PR #2019, cited from the Jira comment, brought the ImagingSelection update into the main history.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira implementation pointer aligns with the source changes checked here.

evidence_items.summary: Current notes intentionally direct DICOM UIDs represented in ImagingSelection.identifier to use system urn:dicom:uid and value prefix urn:oid:.
evidence_items.learned: Remaining urn:oid values in Identifier examples do not indicate a missed UID-element conversion.
